summary: Stated the repair options for the RequestAddNode contract mismatch, mirroring what the ReadIndex account already does. Because the captured evidence does not show which side is normative, the choice is between documenting the stored-address requirement in the exported comment and changing the request path so that promoting an existing observer reuses its stored address without target validation, while the add path keeps its validator and empty-target rejection. Naming both keeps the finding actionable without asserting a fix that was neither applied nor tested. Conclusion, defect claim and receipts are unchanged. Validation reports valid, no_change false, execution_requested false, with an interpretation append changing only the rationale. No execution was run.
